name: nerd4rent
description: Daily developer workflow automation — bootstrap new projects with git init, README scaffold, GitHub remote via gh, matching Linear project, and routing to a spec-creating skill of choice; write well-specified Linear issues (with checklist or sub-issue decomposition); drive a Linear issue through a status-driven plan-implement-review workflow; mechanically close out an issue (commit, push, merge PR/MR on GitHub or GitLab, set Done); and manage a personal agent-skills manifest across Claude Code, Cursor, and other coding agents.
